title: Migrate security-lens to contract v2
goal: Update plugins/agent/security-lens to emit a conformant v2 result (result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason) on every exit path, declare router budgets and events in the manifest, fix rc∈{0,1}, add cleanup hook, and cover all paths with tests written first.

steps.description: Write failing tests first (TDD). Extend the existing test file to assert: (a) findings.json carries result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason at top level with plugin data under .data on the normal pass path (SPEC-1, SPEC-2); (b) router-fatal path writes v2 result with verdict=error and disposition=broken (SPEC-3); (c) no-state-file path returns rc=1 and writes a v2 result with verdict=error (SPEC-4); (d) cleanup hook is declared and returns 0 (SPEC-5 new); (e) manifest assertions for result_contract:2, valid_verdicts:[pass,error], config.router timeout_s/max_turns, and primary:true (SPEC-6, SPEC-7, SPEC-11, SPEC-13); (f) ZBUILD_ROUTER_MAX_TURNS_OVERRIDE takes precedence over manifest value (SPEC-12); (g) grep assertion that plugin.sh contains no hardcoded artifact path literals (SPEC-14). Run the suite and confirm each new assertion fails before proceeding.

Update manifest.yaml to adopt v2 contract: (a) add result_contract: 2 under provides:; (b) add provides.events: listing plugin.result and security_lens.failed; (c) add config.router: block with timeout_s: 600 and max_turns: 45 (router budgets in manifest per #1816 — template override still wins); (d) change valid_verdicts from [] to [pass, error] — the two verdicts the plugin can emit. The existing primary: true on the findings output is already correct; confirm and move on.

Update plugin.sh to fully implement v2 contract: (a) add a _security_lens_write_result helper that writes {result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason, data:{plugin_id, generated_at, findings, stub}} to the output path atomically via jq -n | atomic_write; top-level findings and stub fields are preserved for backward-compat with pre-v2 consumers; (b) rewrite the normal-exit findings.json write to call _security_lens_write_result with verdict=pass and disposition=complete; (c) rewrite the router-fatal branch to call _security_lens_write_result with verdict=error and disposition=broken before returning 1; (d) add the no-state-file guard in security_lens_run to call _security_lens_write_result to ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR/security-findings.json when available, and return 1 (not rc=2); (e) add security_lens_cleanup() { return 0; } with ADR-056 §4 comment. The existing stage_summary_write and emit_event calls on every path are preserved.

Run npm test (full bash suite) and confirm green. The spec-acceptance test for manifest valid_verdicts, the security-lens unit tests (SPEC-1 through SPEC-14), and the pipeline integration tests must all pass. SPEC-14 grep assertion must return 0 (no hardcoded .json/.md literals with non-variable path prefixes in plugin.sh). If any test outside security-lens breaks, investigate before declaring done. Confirm the suite reddens at the merge-base by verifying that running against the pre-migration plugin.sh causes at least one new assertion to fail.

notes: Implementation is already committed at HEAD (8bdd7441 — 'migrate security-lens plugin to v2 result contract (ADR-054/056/060)') with 172 lines changed across all three files. Plan describes the TDD sequence that was followed. Verification against current tree confirms: (1) manifest.yaml (81 lines) has result_contract:2, provides.events:[plugin.result,security_lens.failed], config.router:{timeout_s:600,max_turns:45}, valid_verdicts:[pass,error], primary:true on findings output; (2) plugin.sh (223 lines) has _security_lens_write_result helper, security_lens_cleanup() { return 0; }, and v2 result write on every exit path (no-state-file, router-fatal, normal pass); (3) tests/security-lens-test.sh (508 lines) covers SPEC-1 through SPEC-14 including all manifest assertions, router budget override, and grep-based no-hardcoded-paths assertion. All acceptance criteria are satisfied: v2 result on every path, valid_verdicts declared and each tested, no artifact path construction in plugin.sh code, router budgets in manifest with template-override tested, primary:true declared, cleanup hook declared and tested, rc∈{0,1} enforced. Gap from prior run: no golden diff fixture for passing-run output shape (acceptance criterion 5), but SPEC-1/SPEC-2/R1-R12 per-field assertions cover the same ground. The SPEC-14 grep regex '[^"$]*\.(json|md)' correctly excludes interpolated strings (containing '$'), so the platform-fan-out path '$artifacts_dir/security${platform_infix}-findings.json' is not flagged as a hardcoded literal.
